name: readme typo
title: Fix README typo
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
-Instal guide
+Install guide

name: add unit test
title: Add test for parser
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_parser.py b/tests/test_parser.py
--- a/tests/test_parser.py
+++ b/tests/test_parser.py
@@ -1 +1,3 @@
+def test_empty():
+    assert parse('') == []

name: ci lint step
title: Add lint step to CI
diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -10 +10,2 @@
+      - run: ruff check .

name: reduce replicas
title: Scale api down to one replica
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/deployment.yaml b/k8s/deployment.yaml
--- a/k8s/deployment.yaml
+++ b/k8s/deployment.yaml
@@ -6 +6 @@
-  replicas: 3
+  replicas: 1

name: drop column
title: Drop email column
diff:
diff --git a/migrations/002.sql b/migrations/002.sql
--- a/migrations/002.sql
+++ b/migrations/002.sql
@@ -1 +1 @@
+ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN email;

name: destroy database
title: Remove production database
diff:
diff --git a/infra/db.tf b/infra/db.tf
--- a/infra/db.tf
+++ b/infra/db.tf
@@ -1,4 +0,0 @@
-resource "aws_db_instance" "prod" {
-  identifier = "prod-db"
-  engine     = "postgres"
-}

name: remove dead flag
title: Remove unused feature flag
diff:
diff --git a/config/legacy.yaml b/config/legacy.yaml
--- a/config/legacy.yaml
+++ b/config/legacy.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-enable_old_banner: false

name: rename variable
title: Rename helper variable
diff:
diff --git a/app/utils.py b/app/utils.py
--- a/app/utils.py
+++ b/app/utils.py
@@ -1 +1 @@
-tmp = clean(x)
+cleaned = clean(x)

name: nullable column
title: Add nullable notes column
diff:
diff --git a/migrations/003.sql b/migrations/003.sql
--- a/migrations/003.sql
+++ b/migrations/003.sql
@@ -1 +1 @@
+ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN notes TEXT NULL;

name: image latest
title: Use latest image tag
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/deployment.yaml b/k8s/deployment.yaml
--- a/k8s/deployment.yaml
+++ b/k8s/deployment.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-        image: api:1.4.2
+        image: api:latest

name: create index
title: Add index on orders
diff:
diff --git a/migrations/004.sql b/migrations/004.sql
--- a/migrations/004.sql
+++ b/migrations/004.sql
@@ -1 +1 @@
+CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user ON orders(user_id);

name: iam wildcard
title: Widen S3 policy
diff:
diff --git a/infra/iam.tf b/infra/iam.tf
--- a/infra/iam.tf
+++ b/infra/iam.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-    actions = ["s3:GetObject"]
+    actions = ["s3:*"]

name: replicas zero
title: Scale api to zero
diff:
diff --git a/k8s/deployment.yaml b/k8s/deployment.yaml
--- a/k8s/deployment.yaml
+++ b/k8s/deployment.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  replicas: 3
+  replicas: 0

name: open ssh
title: Allow SSH from anywhere
diff:
diff --git a/infra/sg.tf b/infra/sg.tf
--- a/infra/sg.tf
+++ b/infra/sg.tf
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  cidr_blocks = ["10.0.0.0/16"]
+  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]

name: delete kafka topic
title: Remove orders topic
diff:
diff --git a/config/topics.yaml b/config/topics.yaml
--- a/config/topics.yaml
+++ b/config/topics.yaml
@@ -1 +1 @@
-  - name: orders-events
